# FLX-3628: a consumer query or view nests deeper than sqlglot can read

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

sqlglot raised a RecursionError while reading or checking the text. The text is refused with this code rather than letting the error escape. Flatten the nesting of the text.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3628
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
